m15.text: The Kalonian Wilds are the forest where Yisan and Jalira journey after reading the journal of the Thunian scout Hastric, which reveals a sliver hive with abandoned treasure, fending off corrupted beasts and avoiding Talrand's aerial patrols.
They find the sliver cave, where Jalira uses blue smoke on them over Yisan's objections, and they are transformed into slivers and fight to keep their minds against the hum of the hive.

In the central chamber the hivelord drops their sliver forms, and they take as many coins and treasures as they can carry, after which Yisan decides to stay and study the slivers' music while Jalira takes the treasure to Martyne.
